text: This is so cute and easy to use! I look forward to making the bee, flower, and ladybug happy! My request would be to be able to edit groups. I have one called Most Important, and I thought of a new habit to add to that group, but I can't. I don't think I can delete a group and start it again, either. This is minor. I ❤️ this!

text: cute and does exactly what it says it does but maybe a little too simple? edit: changed this to 2 stars because there's no way to fix it if you forget to check off a day, the streak counter automatically resets :(

developer_reply: Hello there! Thank you so much for the feedback! We've taken your feedback into consideration and added the ability to fix forgotten days in our latest update. We hope that helps! =]
